text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O is now ready to take on 
the Sprinter's Stakes for a second time.

In the waiting room before the race, there 
was something going on that I didn't quite 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Ms. Flower, stop right there!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please do wait a moment. I'm thinking a 
little right now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Errm, well, in this case… Mumblemumblemumble.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Ms. Bakushin O's Trainer. What's the 
meaning of all this…?

Sakura Bakushin O suddenly ran out of the 
waiting room and pulled Nishino Flower 
with her. I'm sure she has some sort of 
agenda…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's ready!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ms. Flower!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'm declaring you chief 
advisor to the class president!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Chief… advisor?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What's this!? My message wasn't received!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes, that! I declare victory!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I swear to you that I will run fair and 
square in this Sprinter's Stakes and best 
you outright!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And… with this victory, I'll prove just 
how much I've grown!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, Ms. Flower, please allow me to race 
against such a skilled Uma as you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Allow this Class Stayer, who ran the whole 
3600 meters!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Class Stayer…?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, anyway, with all I can, I'll do my 
best, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Certainly!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, let's fight like we always do!

Thanking the kind Nishino Flower, I sent 
Sakura Bakushin O off.
